item.title: Spotting the Unseen: How Netflix’s Pixel‑Error AI Revolutionizes Video QC
item.description: Discover how Netflix engineers built a real‑time neural network that detects hot and dead pixels at full resolution, slashing manual review from hours to minutes and letting creators focus on storytelling.

item.title: The Third Era ofAI Coding: Autonomous Agents Building Software Factories
item.description: Michael Truell explains how AI-assisted coding evolved from tab autocomplete to synchronous agents and now to autonomous cloud agents that handle large tasks independently, reshaping developer roles and Cursor's workflow.

item.title: Beyond the P‑Value:How Netflix Builds Confidence in A/B Test Decisions
item.description: In this episode, Netflix engineers reveal the holistic framework they use to turn statistical results into confident product decisions—examining hypothesis alignment, metric storytelling, variant consistency, and the limits of p‑values.

item.title: ModelOnce, Represent Everywhere: How Netflix’s UDA Connects Data Across Systems
item.description: Learn how Netflix’s Unified Data Architecture (UDA) uses a knowledge‑graph approach to define domain models once and automatically generate consistent schemas, pipelines, and discoverable data across GraphQL, Data Mesh, Iceberg, and more.

item.title: Running a 397B Mixture‑of‑Experts Model on a MacBook Pro: Apple’s LLM in a Flash Realized
item.description: Dan Woods shows how Claude Code autonomously engineered a local inference stack for Qwen 3.5 397B, streaming its 209 GB weights from SSD to achieve 5.7 tokens/sec with just 5.5 GB RAM, revealing how Apple’s unified memory and SSD bandwidth enable frontier‑scale AI on a laptop.

item.title: The Big Lie AboutCompetition: Why Most Rivals Aren't Really Trying
item.description: Shaan Puri explains how the perception of intense competition is often exaggerated, highlighting that many contenders lack seriousness and urging listeners to focus on executing a simple idea with dedication, as Charlie Munger advises.

item.title: Taming Tail Latency: Netflix’s Journey with Generational ZGC
item.description: Discover how Netflix switched to Generational ZGC on JDK 21, slashing GC pause times to under a millisecond, cutting tail latency, and gaining operational simplicity without sacrificing throughput.

item.title: Inside Karpathy's Autoresearch: Building Reliable AI Agents Through Constrained Harnesses
item.description: Discover how Karpathy's tiny Autoresearch system turns AI research into a disciplined, time‑bounded optimization loop—and what it teaches us about designing robust agentic harnesses.
